content.title: Apply karne wale ho?
content.subtitle: Last week mein dhoondhoge toh deadline nikal jaayegi.

steps.title: Passport
steps.detail: Valid hona chahiye aur naam baaki documents se match kare. Expiry date abhi check karo.
steps.tip: Spelling ka mismatch sabse common galti hai.

steps.title: Marksheets aur transcripts
steps.detail: Har semester ki copies scan karke ek folder mein. Official transcript ka process college se pehle pooch lo.

steps.title: Test score reports
steps.detail: IELTS, TOEFL, PTE ya GRE, jo bhi diya. Score report ka PDF aur login details sambhal ke rakho.

steps.title: Updated resume
steps.detail: Saaf format, seedhi lines. Projects, internships aur achievements upar rakho.

steps.title: SOP aur LOR drafts
steps.detail: Final na ho toh bhi chalega. Draft ready hai toh editing ka time milta hai.
steps.tip: Har file ka naam aisa rakho: Naam_Document_University.

caption:
Application season mein sabse zyada time documents dhoondhne mein jaata hai. Ye 5 abhi ready karo 👇

1. Passport
2. Marksheets aur transcripts
3. Test score reports
4. Updated resume
5. SOP aur LOR drafts

Save karo 📌 aur us dost ko bhejo jise iski zaroorat hai.

👉 app.goeduabroad.com

#StudyAbroad #IndianStudents #StudyAbroadTips #EduAbroad #StudyAbroadChecklist
